name: Alpenhotel Kramerwirt
beschreibung: The Alpenhotel Kramerwirt in Söll is a four-star hotel. Located in the Hochsöll district, it boasts direct ski-in/ski-out access to the SkiWelt ski area. The rooms are furnished in a modern alpine style. The culinary offerings include a breakfast buffet and an evening dinner menu. The wellness area features an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation zones. A kids' club and playroom are available for families with children. In summer, the hotel serves as an ideal base for hiking and mountain biking tours.
